name: lrm-status
description: Read-only LRM (hacvilke/lrm) P2P VCS queries for the agent: repo status, log, peers. Requires 'lrm' added to plugins.allowedCommands and the lrm binary on PATH.

tools.name: lrm_repo_status
tools.description: Show the LRM repo state in the current project (branch, commits, dirty files).

tools.name: lrm_repo_log
tools.description: Show recent LRM commit history for the current project.

tools.name: lrm_repo_peers
tools.description: List P2P peers discovered for the LRM repo (LAN mDNS / WAN keys).
